input.quote: ARTICLE III OWNERSHIP Licensee acknowledges that Licensor owns all right, title, and interest in and to the Licensed Technology and all Intellectual Property Rights therein.
input.rationale: Article III vests all right, title and interest in the Licensed Technology and its IP in Licensor, and "DERIVATIVE WORK" (1.3) is defined to capture any additions, modifications, improvements or enhancements based on the Licensed Technology. Combined with Article VII(b), under which we pay Licensor for further development and customization work including a unique client front end, the drafting means we own nothing we pay to have developed and receive only the narrow, terminable, Field-of-Use licence in Article II. There is also no provision anywhere reserving our rights in our own trading, order, client and account data or configurations, and Article I's "Intellectual Property Rights" and "Confidential Information" definitions run only in Licensor's favour. That falls short of the playbook position that we own deliverables created for us and retain all rights in our data, with Licensor keeping its pre-existing platform IP subject to a licence back. The redline adds a narrow carve-out to Article III (Licensee Data ownership, assignment of paid-for customization deliverables with a perpetual royalty-free licence back of embedded Licensor IP, and no joint ownership) without disturbing Licensor's ownership of the Platform.

proposal.summary: Carve Licensee Data and paid-for customization deliverables out of Licensor's blanket ownership in Article III, with a licence-back of embedded Licensor IP and no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article III gives Licensor ownership of all Licensed Technology and Derivative Works (defined to include additions, improvements and enhancements), which would sweep in our trading and client data and the custom front end we pay Licensor to build under Article VII(b); our position is that we own our data and what we pay to have developed, while Licensor keeps its platform IP. We have therefore added an ownership carve-out with a licence back of any embedded Licensor IP, and would accept as a fallback Licensor ownership of the customization deliverables plus a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence for us to use, modify and sublicense them for our business.

ops.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing: (a) Licensee retains all right, title and interest in and to all data and content submitted, generated or transmitted by or on behalf of Licensee through the Licensed Technology, including its trading, order, client and account data and its records, reports and configurations (collectively, "Licensee Data"), Licensor acquires no right, title or interest in Licensee Data, and Licensor shall use Licensee Data solely to perform its obligations under this Agreement; (b) all customization work, deliverables and work product developed by Licensor specifically for Licensee and paid for by Licensee (including any unique client front end developed under Article VII(b)) shall be owned by Licensee, and Licensor hereby assigns to Licensee all right, title and interest therein, provided that Licensor retains ownership of its pre-existing Licensed Technology and Intellectual Property Rights and hereby grants Licensee a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense any such pre-existing materials to the extent embedded in or reasonably necessary to use such deliverables; and (c) nothing in this Agreement creates or shall be construed to create joint ownership of any Intellectual Property Rights.
